exact_statement: For every Boolean seed g under every finite interior independent product law, and independent selector X of arbitrary success probability e, activation F=1-X+Xg satisfies Delta_F=e Delta_g+Delta_o and J_F=e J_g+J_o+ln(4) C, where Delta_o=e(1-e)Var(g), J_o<=3ln(4)Delta_o sharply, and C=e^2 sum_T P_g(T)[j(e|c_T|)-j(e)-j(|c_T|)] has summand indices in {0,1}. The complete inherited reference retains both full terminal laws and satisfies KL_tree=KL_o+e KL_g, CE_tree^+=J_F-ln(4)C+n_o+e n_g, and KL_flat-KL_tree=ln(4)C+n_F-n_o-e n_g. For the actual activated AND2 seed g=-1+2yz at p_y=p_z=(1+t)/2 and e=1-2t, t=2^-m, m>=3, C/Delta_o=e(1+t)/(t(3+t))>=(6/25)2^m diverges. Moreover ln(4)C/L_g tends to one, while the signed flat/tree transfer tends to -[(3/4)ln3-(1/2)ln4]<0. Thus no absolute constant pays this carry from the fresh outer deficit alone. Independently, the exact activation entropy bound is E_o<=(4+ln4)Delta_o, sharp as e and a=(1-Eg)/2 tend to one. Genuine disjoint nested canalyzing decision-list gates on distinct variables therefore satisfy corrected E<=(4+ln4)(I-Var) at every product bias, with no depth or fan-in dependence; arbitrary-seed composition preserves max(C_seed,4+ln4). On the uniform cube the ordinary bit-entropy FEI constant is 2+4/ln2. These family bounds and the carry obstruction do not pay an arbitrary seed dyadic scale or prove universal FEI.

exact_statement: Let g be any finite Boolean sign under an interior independent product law, mu=Eg, a=(1-mu)/2 in (0,1), V=4a(1-a), I=I(g), and let X be independent Bernoulli epsilon=2^-k, k>=1 integer. Put F=1 on X=0 and F=g on X=1. For occupied nonempty coefficients c_T choose j_T by 1/2<2^j_T|c_T|<=1, P_T=v_T*c_T^2, W_T=v_T*4^-j_T, Z_g=sum W_T, J_g=ln4 sum P_T*j_T, Delta_g=I-V. Write j_a for the cell of a, b=4^-j_a, B=V+4a^2*j_a. Then Delta_F=epsilon*Delta_g+epsilon*(1-epsilon)*V and J_F=epsilon*J_g+ln4[epsilon*(1-epsilon)*B+epsilon^2*k*V], with V<=B<=2V, zero composition carry, and sharp outer-gate bound J_outer<=3ln4*Delta_outer, equality at a=epsilon=1/2. Consequently a seed bound J_g<=KDelta_g is preserved under finite independent dyadic activations with constant max(K,3ln4). The corrected entropy obeys E_F=epsilon*E_g+epsilon*(1-epsilon)*V*ln4+2epsilon^2*V*ln(1/epsilon)+4epsilon*(1-epsilon)*a^2*ln(1/a^2), valid for any interior epsilon. For the complete flat dyadic references with actual empty mass, Z_F=epsilon*Z_g+4epsilon*(1-epsilon)*b, w=4a*epsilon*(1-a*epsilon), s=4epsilon*(1-epsilon)*a^2/w, t=4epsilon*(1-epsilon)*b/Z_F, and full ordinary KL_F=epsilon*KL_g+w*d_Bern(s||t). The full composed reference has t_outer obtained by replacing Z_g with V and retains epsilon*KL_g. With Z_outer=epsilon*V+4epsilon*(1-epsilon)*b, the positive normalizer transfer is 0<=w*ln(Z_F/Z_outer)<=epsilon*(Z_g-V); the exact signed flat/tree conversion also subtracts epsilon*V*ln(Z_g/V), replacing its KL together with the reference. Uniformly in the seed, |J_F/epsilon-J_g-ln4*B|<=ln4*epsilon*(k+2)*V. For a fixed nonconstant seed the full KL endpoint is KL_F/epsilon -> KL_g+4a*d_Bern(a||4b/(Z_g+4b)). Constants give actual constant or signed-literal zero-deficit/unit-atom laws; reflecting X covers the corresponding probability-one endpoint. These are natural-log identities and original-owner transfers; arbitrary seed J payment and full FEI remain open.

The complete reference Q_* retains actual empty/singleton masses and distributes total high mass M in proportion to W_A=v_A 4^-j_A. Its normalizer satisfies 0<=n_hi=M ln(Z_hi/M)<=(ln4)(Delta-R), and E=E_single+J_hi+n_hi-KL(P||Q_*). Its complete corrected cross entropy is no greater than A044 flat-reference cross entropy, by the exact full-sector KL chain rule. With S=4Delta-2R-E_single>=0 and U=sum_high P_A ln(4(2^j_A|c_A|)^2)>=0, E=J_hi+(4+ln4)Delta-(2+ln4)R-S-U. These complete references compose through genuine disjoint prime decompositions with additive weighted ordinary KL and no lost terminals. A common J_hi<=KDelta for every precisely defined prime at every induced law implies universal corrected E<=(K+4+ln4)Delta and uniform bit FEI with constant max(K+4+ln4,1)/ln2. The prime high-scale bound is equivalent up to this additive constant to universal product-biased corrected FEI+ and remains unproved.
